input.name: dogfood
input.args: {"task":{"medium":"drive","prompt":"On a running substrate, mail `aether.tcp.bind_listener { addr: \"127.0.0.1:0\" }` to `aether.tcp`, note the bound port, then mail `aether.tcp.connect { addr: \"127.0.0.1:<port>\" }` to the same cap. Confirm the `ConnectResult` is `Ok` with a `session_name`, `session_id`, and a loopback `peer`, then mail `aether.tcp.session_write { bytes }` to the returned connect-side session and confirm no error/close is surfaced. The task is impossible without the new outbound surface — there is no other way to originate a TCP connection through the cap.","surfaceUnderTest":"the `aether.tcp.connect` / `aether.tcp.connect_result` kinds on the `aether.tcp` mailbox, plus `session_write` / `session_close` reused on the dialed session.","expectedArtifact":"none — TCP transport, nothing renders; correctness is read from the `ConnectResult::Ok` reply and the absence of a session-close error."}}
